stories.title: Austin Smotherman Wins Bank of Utah Championship — First Title in 100th Start
stories.angle: The 100th-start milestone win is one of the most compelling storylines in the sport — perseverance rewarded.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Post 1 (8:00 AM ET — Announcement)**
Austin Smotherman just won his first PGA Tour title — in his 100th career start. 26-under at Black Desert Resort. Two shots over Doug Ghim. $1,080,000. Entry into the Masters. Sometimes it just takes time. #PGATour #BankOfUtah

article.headline: Austin Smotherman Wins Bank of Utah Championship in His 100th Career Start

research.facts:
Austin Smotherman Wins Bank of Utah Championship
**Sources:** pgatour.com, Yahoo Sports, nbcsports.com, golfchannel.com, stgeorgeutah.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Tournament: Bank of Utah Championship 2026
- Course: Black Desert Resort, Ivins, Utah
- Date: Final round October 4, 2026
- Winner: Austin Smotherman
- Total score: 26-under 258
- Final round: 68 (-3)
- Margin: 2 shots
- Runner-up: Doug Ghim (24-under, final round 69)
- Purse: $6 million
- Winner's share: $1,080,000
- Notable moments: Double bogey on par-4 13th (approach plugged in bunker); 70-foot eagle putt lagged to 2 feet on 18 for easy tap-in birdie
- Career start: 100th career start
- Smotherman age: 32
- After 3 rounds: 23-under 190 (tournament record through 54 holes), leading by 2
- Rewards: 2-year Tour exemption (through 2028); entry into Masters, PGA Championship, The Players Championship; qualifies for "Championship Series" starting 2028
**Story Type:** NEW

stories.title: LIV Golf October 13 Deadline — 7 Days for Players to Secure 52.5% Ownership
stories.angle: The countdown to golf's most consequential deadline since the original LIV announcement.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Post 3 (10:30 AM ET — Countdown)**
One week from today, LIV Golf's October 13 restructuring deadline arrives. Players who sign must commit to LIV 2.0 and become 52.5% owners in the new entity. About half the player field needs to sign. The clock is ticking. #LIVGolf #Golf

article.headline: LIV Golf's October 13 Deadline: One Week for Players to Shape the Future

research.facts:
LIV Golf October 13 Deadline
**Sources:** golfmonthly.com, westhawaiitoday.com, newstribune.com, todays-golfer.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LIV Golf filed for bankruptcy protection: September 8, 2026
- October 13 deadline: 35 days after bankruptcy filing
- Investor: BC Partners; lead person: Ted Goldthorpe
- Term: New entity would be 52.5% player-owned
- Deadline requirement: "Requisite number of players" — roughly half the players with claims against LIV must sign up for LIV 2.0
- LIV CEO stated August 2026: "Funding secured to play beyond 2026"
- Players cannot be guaranteed by LIV yet: Rahm, DeChambeau (per ten-golf.com)
- Background: PGA Tour-LIV merger talks began ~Sept 2025 but fell apart by Dec 31 deadline
**Story Type:** FOLLOW UP (previous: Sept 29 pipeline covered Oct 13 deadline as 14 days away)

x_posts.text:

PGA Tour tees it up in Japan this week: Baycurrent Classic at Yokohama Country Club, Oct. 8-11. $8M purse. 500 FedExCup points. Only official PGA Tour event in Asia. Xander Schauffele is the defending champ. #BaycurrentClassic #PGATour

article.headline: Baycurrent Classic Preview: PGA Tour Heads to Japan for $8 Million Asian Stop

Baycurrent Classic Preview
**Sources:** pgatour.com, golfchannel.com, jbsagolf.com, aol.com Golf Glance
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Tournament: Baycurrent Classic 2026
- Course: Yokohama Country Club (West Course), Yokohama, Japan
- Dates: October 8-11, 2026
- Purse: $8 million
- FedExCup points: 500
- Field: 72 players, no-cut format
